plugins.cameraPermission: LuulScan needs camera access to scan and identify gemstones, minerals, and jewelry.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: LuulScan records the location where you scan a specimen, so you can see your finds on a map. This is optional.

plugins.photosPermission: LuulScan needs access to your photos so you can upload an existing picture of a gemstone, mineral, coin, or jewelry to identify it.
